page_summary:
Five Novels of the 1960s and 70s is the canonical works record for PKD's novel. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is Five Novels of the 1960s and 70s (Library of America) (2008).

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.
